text:
Maya: kicking off topic selection for next webinar. top-level goal: drive trials from product & infra teams. thinking a hybrid format: 25m keynote (benchmarks + customer impact) + two parallel 20m breakouts (1. Quick integration lab, 2. Cost & latency playbook). opinions?

Eli: hybrid sounds right. keep keynote very story-forward: 3 case bullets (before/after), one concrete metric. breakouts should be tactical.

Hannah: agree. suggest we name breakouts for clarity: "Integrate in 20" and "Save per-token $10k/mo" (playful). also we need clear audience cues on signup.

Jonah: run-of-show sketch:
- 00:00–02:00 host intro + goals
- 02:00–12:00 keynote: benchmark narrative + customer snippet
- 12:00–15:00 live Qs + poll 1 (problem area)
- 15:00–40:00 parallel breakouts (attendees choose)
- 40:00–50:00 wrap + CTA + post-event triage
Make sure WFH-friendly timings and allow 3m transition to breakouts.

Maya: love the sketch. polls: 1) primary optimization (cost/latency/reliability/integration), 2) want lab? yes/no. can we gate lab with a short RSVP?

Eli: lab gating is good. set limit 100. provide a pre-install checklist and a hosted sandbox for those who can't install.

Hannah: speaker confirmations: keynote -> Priya (benchmarks), customer -> Acme (short 3-min), integrate breakout -> Chris + demo engineer, cost breakout -> Sam + product PM. can we confirm availability by Wed?

Jonah: tech/rehearsal requirements:
```
- full dress 48h before (slides + demo flows)
- 1h staging check 1h before (audio, breakout links)
- fallback videos: keynote 8m, each breakout 5m
- moderator script with handoffs + timing pings
```

Maya: good. ops-bot: can you create the rehearsal events and check recording permissions?

ops-bot: Rehearsal events created. Recording permissions: enabled for hosts only. Reminder set for 48h and 1h checks.

Eli: sign-up page fields: name, email, company, role, preferred breakout (Integrate/Cost/No preference), willingness to share small demo logs (opt-in checkbox), primary cloud. include UTM capture.

Hannah: lead routing plan: integrate RSVPs -> solutions SDR + engineer follow-up. cost breakout -> product/value SDR. keynote-only -> growth SDR. Also tag "willing to share logs" for CS.

Jonah: measurement: capture attendees by breakout, poll responses, lab RSVPs -> trial start within 14 days. KPI targets: 15% trial opt-in for lab RSVPs, 6% for cost breakout, 3% keynote-only.

Maya: fallback plan: if breakout tech fails route everyone to main room with prerecorded breakout and open Q&A. make sure hosts have direct chat numbers for engineers.

Eli: volunteers for lab support? I'll take morning shift. Hannah will do chat moderation. need two more engineers.

Hannah: I'll roster Devon and Lee. Jonah can you add them to rehearsal invite?

Jonah: done. calendar-bot: Webinar event "Benchmarks to Production: Playbooks + Labs" scheduled for 2025-11-05 18:00 UTC. Rehearsal full-dress: 2025-11-03 17:00 UTC.

Maya: timeline: abstracts due Tue, speaker confirmations Wed, signup live by end of week, pre-records by Oct 28. keep updates to this thread only. thanks! :tada:
